build.command: docker build -t your-registry/your-app:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) . && docker push your-registry/your-app:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)

deploy.command: kubectl set image deployment/your-app your-app=your-registry/your-app:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && kubectl rollout status deployment/your-app
kubectl --context=production set image deployment/your-app your-app=your-registry/your-app:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && kubectl --context=production rollout status deployment/your-app
kubectl --context=staging set image deployment/your-app your-app=your-registry/your-app:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && kubectl --context=staging rollout status deployment/your-app
